scope: Bounded local Media/Connect/Nova implementation and semantic reconciliation. Existing account identity and media/publishing authority preserved. No production migration, deployment, commercial conversion or provider inference performed.
decision: ADR 0165 accepted from explicit user mandate; delivery local. Initial operator entitlement is a stated implementation assumption, not a commercial pass decision.

corrections_and_failed_attempts: Initial sandboxed font downloads and local HTTP listens were restricted; approved build/test reruns succeeded.

Added auth-user deletion test correctly exposed the pre-existing immutable canonical identity guard. No account-erasure policy or guard was changed. Final fixture verifies atomic retention, independent revocation/entitlement withdrawal and new ON DELETE CASCADE metadata; no completed deletion is claimed.
Connect middleware exemption was placed after published-Site hostname restriction and a behavioral regression verifies denied Connect routes there.

Legacy transport JSON aggregation supplies a default finish reason. Nova now requests original SSE for both client response modes and validates finish plus completion marker itself; missing evidence remains unknown.

Independent UI review found a disconnect Label-in-Name mismatch. Hidden application text now augments the complete visible label; fixture synchronized pending-label transitions and scoped authored alerts away from the framework announcer.

semantic_review.connect: New explicit domain maps every added implementation/reference/test path. Scope is reviewed public clients, existing identity, inference-only grants, explicit entitlement, shared bounded admission and honest outcomes.
semantic_review.access: Exact Connect entries bypass legacy preview and unrelated cookie refresh only. Independent verified-account APIs and resource-scoped admission remain mandatory; published Site hostnames stay closed to application routes.
semantic_review.images: Product-doc changes distinguish external text capability from existing private image allowance and Star publication authority. No image route, storage, artifact, visibility or publication implementation changed; media authorization/public-boundary regressions pass.
semantic_review.sites: API_BASE_URL now describes the separate Connect capability. Existing Site authority and retired authoring contracts remain; hostname isolation is explicitly tested. No Site entitlement or publication is added.
semantic_review.relay: New Nova executor reuses conservative execution transport, delegates server-derived identity, requests original terminal evidence, and introduces no alternate retry, fallback or deployment. Architecture/security guides distinguish new product admission from provider authorization.
semantic_review.database: Six private additive tables, forced RLS and explicit deny to browser/service-role Data API, hashed credentials, serialized reuse/revocation/admission and paired scoped rollback. No existing records seeded or migrated. Account retention remains separate.
semantic_review.delivery: Package adds local test commands and public-client module export; no deployment command, workflow or runtime target changed. Feature disabled by default, migration and hosted acceptance separate. Existing overdue prevention deadlines are not extended.
semantic_review.client-efficiency: Connect extends AuthEntryShell, suppresses Media chrome, aborts obsolete reads and unmounts on owner change. No polling, auto inference replay or automatic purchase; captured state checks and independent UI review are scoped to this surface.
semantic_review.knowledge: Full affected guide bodies separate capability from private operations; new ADR explicitly records partial product interpretation replacement without auto-superseding earlier media/commercial decisions. Fingerprints attest the bounded changed contract and listed guides, not an exhaustive review of every file in broad domain inventories.

unmapped_paths: Initial impact identified all new Connect files; registry now maps them explicitly. Generated indexes, private dated evidence and design-sidecar records are reviewed as documentation artifacts rather than new public capabilities.
remaining_limits: Disabled by default. No production schema/configuration/host registration or deployment performed.
No actual hosted account-to-provider inference completion; browser acceptance uses intercepted synthetic responses and disposable database acceptance uses a synthetic executor.
Only text inference, reviewed browser/native public clients, no tool execution, async retrieval, marketplace, wallet, purchasing or subdelegation.
Existing commercial subscriptions are not automatically converted. Operator grants are the initial explicit entitlement source.
Browser runtime tokens stay in memory; reload requires reconnecting. A host offering arbitrary agent code must enforce process/storage credential isolation.
Account deletion remains subject to existing identity-retention guards; Connect introduces no erasure workflow.
Local build/response/asset scans do not certify the live site. Overdue incident prevention actions remain open.
